title: 'Glo Wild' at the Fort Wayne Zoo's lantern festival - NewsBreak
text:
By Gracie Sherrow No media credit provided. ,
2 hours ago FORT WAYNE, Ind. (WANE) – The Fort Wayne Zoo has brought back a shiny new exhibit that is sure to ‘Glo’ you away.
The Fort Wayne Zoo’s ‘Glo Wild’ lantern festival features several awe-inspiring lighting displays. The Fort Wayne Zoo’s ‘Glo Wild’ lantern festival features several awe-inspiring lighting displays. The Fort Wayne Zoo’s ‘Glo Wild’ lantern festival features several awe-inspiring lighting displays. ‘Glo Wild’, a nighttime lantern festival, has returned to the Zoo for a second year and features all-new lighting displays for guests to ‘ooh’ and ‘ahh’.
“We`re thrilled to bring Glo Wild to our community for the second year in a row and showcase the Zoo in an entirely new light with all-new displays from last year,” says Rick Schuiteman, Executive Director of the Fort Wayne Zoo.
The mile-long installation is available to zoo-goers beginning March 5 and runs through May 31 on select evenings.
Tickets are available for purchase online and at the zoo’s box office.
